mapping: D1-D2 constructive sample only; conjunction reorder, no restriction on arbitrary incoming heaps
D1 receiver pointer field read/initialized/access, same quantified inputs
printed_query: forall i:int, i1:int, i2:int, heap:heap, i3:int, i4:int, i5:int. P_t25_repr heap i4 i3 i i1 i5 i2 -> (initialized_at heap i4 i3 /\ pointer_at heap i4 i3 i i1) /\ typed_reads heap i4 i3 8 8
source_statement: \forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer r,o,b,bo,s,c; t25_repr(h,r,o,b,bo,s,c) ==> Heap::typed_reads(h,r,o,8,8) && Heap::initialized_at(h,r,o) && Heap::pointer_at(h,r,o,b,bo)

mapping: D1-D2 original capacity-zero-or-freeable premise; null pair/freeable disjunction reorder
printed_query: forall i:int, i1:int, i2:int, heap:heap, i3:int, i4:int, i5:int. P_t25_repr heap i4 i3 i i1 i5 i2 -> i2 = 0 \/ freeable heap i i1 -> freeable heap i i1 \/ i1 = 0 /\ i = 0
source_statement: \forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer r,o,b,bo,s,c; t25_repr(h,r,o,b,bo,s,c) && (c == 0 || Heap::freeable(h,b,bo)) ==> (b == 0 && bo == 0) || Heap::freeable(h,b,bo)

mapping: D3-D7 release invalidates all offsets/forms/readability of old identity
printed_query: forall i:int, i1:int, heap:heap. let a = release heap i1 in not i1 = 0 -> not forms a i1 i /\ not can_read a i1 i 4

mapping: D4 c>0 simplifies c=0-or-freeable to freeable; all original inputs remain quantified
printed_query: forall i:int, i1:int, i2:int, heap:heap, i3:int, i4:int, i5:int. 0 < i2 -> well_formed heap -> freeable heap i i1 -> P_t25_repr heap i4 i3 i i1 i5 i2 -> not can_read (release heap i) i i1 4
source_statement: \forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer r,o,b,bo,s,c; Heap::well_formed(h) && t25_repr(h,r,o,b,bo,s,c) && (c == 0 || Heap::freeable(h,b,bo)) && c > 0 ==> !Heap::can_read(Heap::release(h,b),b,bo,4)

mapping: D5 nondead live object memory/init frame, same source offsets
printed_query: forall i:int, i1:int, heap:heap, i2:int. let a = release heap i1 in not i1 = i -> live heap i -> contents a i i2 = contents heap i i2 /\ (initialized_at a i i2 <-> initialized_at heap i i2)
source_statement: \forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer dead,b,o; Heap::live(h,b) && b != dead ==> Heap::contents(Heap::release(h,dead),b,o) == Heap::contents(h,b,o) && (Heap::initialized_at(Heap::release(h,dead),b,o) <==> Heap::initialized_at(h,b,o))

printed_query: forall i:int, i1:int, heap:heap. not i1 = i -> same_object heap (release heap i1) i
source_statement: \forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer dead,b; b != dead ==> Heap::same_object(h,Heap::release(h,dead),b)

mapping: D6 receiver/backing overlap deliberately allowed; receiver read invalid after its release
printed_query: forall heap:heap, i:int, i1:int. not i1 = 0 -> not can_read (release heap i1) i1 i 24

mapping: D7 legal fitting address reuse creates fresh identity but never revives old alias
printed_query: forall i:int, heap:heap, i1:int. let x = numerical_address heap i in let a = release heap i in let a1 = allocate a i1 x in 0 < i1 -> (4 * i1) <= bytes heap i -> well_formed heap -> freeable heap i 0 -> aligned x 4 -> ((numerical_address a1 (fresh_id heap) = x /\ available a i1 x) /\ well_formed a1) /\ not can_read a1 i 0 4
source_statement: \forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer b,n; Heap::well_formed(h) && Heap::freeable(h,b,0) && Heap::aligned(Heap::numerical_address(h,b),4) && 0 < n && 4*n <= Heap::bytes(h,b) ==> Heap::available(Heap::release(h,b),n,Heap::numerical_address(h,b)) && Heap::well_formed(Heap::allocate(Heap::release(h,b),n,Heap::numerical_address(h,b))) && Heap::numerical_address(Heap::allocate(Heap::release(h,b),n,Heap::numerical_address(h,b)),Heap::fresh_id(h)) == Heap::numerical_address(h,b) && !Heap::can_read(Heap::allocate(Heap::release(h,b),n,Heap::numerical_address(h,b)),b,0,4)

mapping: D7 existing initialized readable old object implies live before release
printed_query: forall i:int, heap:heap, i1:int. initialized_at heap i i1 -> can_read heap i i1 4 -> live heap i
source_statement: \forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer b,o; Heap::can_read(h,b,o,4) && Heap::initialized_at(h,b,o) ==> Heap::live(h,b)
